## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: sector breadth is weak (3/11) and there is MAJOR divergence across large caps (multiple megacaps showing 1W vs 1M sign conflict), so reduce conviction and monitor for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.59%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +7.70%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +19.32%). Communication showing strength via NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%). Technology mixed but with pockets of strength: INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples lagging: PM BELOW TREND (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%), EL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%). Materials weak: PPG BELOW TREND (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -5.86%), NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -0.70%). Financials soft: GS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%), NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +11.90%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.31% | 1M: -3.30%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +19.32%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: F BELOW TREND (1W: -14.37% | 1M: -9.15%), EL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -6.43%), RCL BELOW TREND (1W: -11.25% | 1M: -13.25%), UPS BELOW TREND (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -5.66%). Weakness concentrated in consumer cyclicals/staples and select industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +18.35%), NFLX (1W: +17.24%), DOW (1W: +14.11%); NOW and ADBE also showing strong 1W lifts. Note MAJOR divergence across megacaps (NVDA, META, AMZN and others have conflicting 1W vs 1M signals) — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/CORRECTION pockets: ADBE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +3.61%), INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +0.10%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%). Tech breadth supportive in places but internal rotation and large-name divergence persist.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak overall with several names BELOW TREND: GS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%), JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -6.77%). Few pockets of stability but sector 1W performance negative; monitor for further dispersion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/neutral with some exhaustion: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +1.62%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +3.35%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -1.85%). Sector showing selective strength but not broad leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to pockets of cyclical strength in Energy and select Communication/Tech winners while reducing exposure to clear losers in Consumer Staples, Materials and weak Financials; style is mixed with no clear market-wide tilt. Given CAUTION and MAJOR divergence, emphasize selectivity and wait for reconfirmation before adding risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) — sentiment-confirmed move; PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%). BEARISH: LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%), GS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) — earnings/geomarket headlines could extend losses.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth part of the 3/11 sector positives) — XOM/CVX/VLO showing strength. BEARISH: Financials and Materials — both under pressure this week and contributing to the CAUTION regime.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA resistance area to watch as a CORRECTION test (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%); AAPL support near recent lows (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.32%)); GS break below near-term support would worsen Financials weakness (GS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NFLX (+55): Netflix headlines on walking away from Warner deal; price confirming (NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%)) — sentiment confirmed. PSX (+55): Analyst upgrades/dividend talk; price confirming (PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +13.32%)).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-55): Fab cost/geopolitics headline; price confirming (LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%)). NVDA (-45): H200 production pause headline; price diverging to slight CORRECTION (NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%)) — watch for distribution. TSLA (-55): regional sales weakness; price confirming (TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.74% | 1M: -3.89%)).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and select Communication/Tech names showing relative strength (XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND, NFLX ABOVE TREND). Key risk is MAJOR divergence among megacaps (NVDA, META, AMZN) and mixed news flow—monitor sentiment-confirmed moves and wait for reconfirmation.
